summary: Phase 4 backend testing complete. Tested new /ai/photo-enhance (Nano Banana) endpoint, /flash-deals list, /admin/flash-deals/rotate, plus light regression on listings, verify/email/send, ai/listing-suggest, seller/apply. 18/18 tests pass.

minor.issue: flash_deal_ends_at is returned as naive-UTC ISO string (no 'Z' or offset). Client code must assume UTC. Consider serializing with explicit tzinfo for clarity.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 2565 lines — long past the >700-line threshold. Should be split into routers (auth, listings, verify, seller, ai, flash_deals, files, orders).

rotate_flash_deals uses deterministic per-listing-id discount (sum(bytearray(id))%55 + 20). Discount never rotates day-over-day for the same listing — advertised as 'random' in PRD; consider making it truly random per rotation.

flash_deals GET endpoint auto-triggers rotate_flash_deals() inline when pool < 10. This means an unauthenticated public request can trigger a Mongo write path. Acceptable but consider gating to a lock/debounce to avoid thundering-herd writes.

photo-enhance response returns 200 with a URL that requires auth (query param ?auth= or Bearer header) — good. But 'url' field is a relative /api/... path; frontend must prepend REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL.
flash_deal_ends_at datetime returned without tzinfo — recommend storing/serializing with explicit UTC offset.
seed_data_creation: No new seed data. Uploaded 1 test image via /api/upload during test_photo_enhance_with_file_id; generated 2 enhanced files via Nano Banana in db.files (source=ai_enhance). No cleanup performed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 4 endpoints all green. Verified: (1) /flash-deals returns 10 items, all with is_flash_deal=true, status=active, discount 20-74, ends_at=next midnight UTC. (2) POST /admin/flash-deals/rotate works for admin, 403 for non-admin, pool capped at 10 across multiple rotations. (3) /ai/photo-enhance (Nano Banana) works with image_base64 and file_id inputs — real Emergent LLM calls, ~5-10s each. Returns id/url/content_type/size/prompt_used; enhanced file is downloadable via /api/files/{id}?auth=<token>. Returns 400 with no input, 404 for unknown file_id, 403 for another user's file. (4) Listing model exposes is_flash_deal, flash_deal_ends_at, flash_deal_discount_pct. Regression on /listings, /listings/{id}, sort=trending, /verify/email/send, /ai/listing-suggest, /seller/apply all pass.
